title: Revert request
description: What basalt revert puts in the revert link: https://basaltvault.app/revert/#1.<base64url(deflate-raw(this JSON))>. See CONTRACT.md, Revert.

binding.description: The binding text exactly as Postgres returned it (revert-binding.schema.json).

lines.description: Revert lines exactly as Postgres returned them, in order (revert-line.schema.json). sha256 of the lines joined by a newline must equal the binding's rowsHash, or for a batched binding its sampleHash (the lines are then the plan's sample: min(1000, rows + skipped) lines).

credentialIds.description: Registered passkey credential ids, base64url, used as allowCredentials. May be empty.
